name: lohagoyo
description: LoHagoYo.cl — plataforma gratuita de servicios de profesionales independientes.

scripts.build:prod: node scripts/sincronizar.mjs && python3 scripts/gerar-og.py && astro build
scripts.publicar: npm run build:prod && firebase deploy --only hosting --project lohagoyo-prod --account hola@lohagoyo.cl
scripts.test:regras: JAVA_HOME=$HOME/.local/jre21/Contents/Home PATH=$HOME/.local/jre21/Contents/Home/bin:$PATH firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-lohagoyo 'vitest run --config vitest.regras.config.ts'
